races.name: Connolly's Red Mills Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Franigane
runners_data.note: Front runner returning after 364 days but faces no pace pressure and can dictate terms with amateur jockey Edgedale on board

runners_data.name: On Lovers Walk
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good recent form with strong going record (10/15 on similar) and benefits from trainer Morgan's perfect recent strike rate

runners_data.name: Great Valley
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner (OR 127) who runs prominently and showed winning form last time, but amateur rider Sankey needs to time challenge perfectly

races.paceDynamic: Franigane will take them along from the front unopposed, with On Lovers Walk and Great Valley both likely to track him in second and third positions through the early stages. With no other pace pressure, Franigane can dictate comfortable fractions and potentially steal a march on his higher-rated rivals who need to hunt him down. The lack of early pace pressure and small field size creates a tactical race where positioning and timing matter more than sustained pressure. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and those who can travel kindly in behind before producing a telling burst.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Franigane Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Franigane can maintain a decent gallop without being pressured early
scenarios.body: He can use his intimate knowledge of front running to kick clear at the right moment while his rivals are still organizing their challenges. The 364-day break becomes irrelevant if he's allowed to control the tempo completely.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Great Valley Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Great Valley's superior rating and recent good form allow him to time his run perfectly
scenarios.body: His OR 127 and winning form give him the tactical speed to overcome the pace scenario when Sankey asks the question. The prominent style suits this setup where he can track and pounce.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: On Lovers Walk Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If On Lovers Walk can use her trainer's excellent recent form (1/1 in last 14 days) and good going record
scenarios.body: Her 10/15 record on similar going and recent race fitness could prove decisive in a tactical finish. The prominent running style allows her to cover any move from Great Valley.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: All three converge in the final furlong with jockey error or jumping mistakes determining the outcome. The least likely scenario given Franigane's confirmed front running style.

watchPoints.text: Franigane's jumping after such a long layoff - any mistake hands initiative to his higher-rated rivals
Great Valley's amateur jockey Mr Sankey and whether he can judge the pace from prominent position against a wily front runner
On Lovers Walk for signs of confidence from the Morgan yard given their 100% recent strike rate
The early pace development - if it becomes pedestrian all three could converge dangerously late
Franigane's fitness levels showing after 364 days off, particularly from the home turn onwards

races.name: Pertemps Network Intermediate Point-To-Point Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Ultimate Survivor
runners_data.note: Lightly raced unknown quantity with highest official rating (120) but concerning lack of recent form data and amateur jockey booking creates significant uncertainty.

runners_data.name: Mister Splash
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up performer with solid RPR of 110 and decent recent Warwick form, but faces tactical disadvantage against likely uncontested leader.

runners_data.name: Fame And Concrete
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with good Warwick experience but long absence since last run (1136 days) raises serious fitness concerns despite trainer having him ready.

runners_data.name: Practice Run
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with consistent recent form (41221-) and trainer-jockey combination suggests confidence, but needs strong pace to be effective.

runners_data.name: The Dancing Tree
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with exceptional current form (11111-) perfectly positioned to exploit weak pace scenario with no genuine early rivals.

runners_data.name: Tellmesomethingood
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from same stable as likely leader but poor recent form (35452-) and lowest official rating (92) makes him hard to recommend.

races.paceDynamic: The Dancing Tree emerges as the clear pace angle with proven front-running credentials and excellent recent form (11111-), likely to dictate terms from the front without serious early pressure. Fame And Concrete may try to track prominently but lacks the consistent pace-pressing ability to trouble The Dancing Tree early. The hold-up brigade of Mister Splash, Practice Run, and Tellmesomethingood will be relying on a strong finish, but the lack of genuine pace pressure means The Dancing Tree can control fractions and kick clear when ready. This race shape heavily favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can secure good positions early, as the hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage against a controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dancing Tree Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Dancing Tree gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions.
scenarios.body: The front-runner can measure out his effort perfectly and kick clear turning for home when the hold-up horses are still trying to get into the race. His excellent current form (11111-) and tactical advantage combine to make him very hard to catch.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or The Dancing Tree weakens in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: Practice Run or Mister Splash can use their finishing kick to maximum effect, with Practice Run's solid form (41221-) and Mister Splash's proven ability at this level giving them the edge. The patient tactics pay off if they get the right setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Fame And Concrete can track The Dancing Tree closely and outbattle him in the straight.
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old's experience tells as he sits in the perfect stalking position and has enough left to forge clear when The Dancing Tree's effort flattens. His recent third at Warwick shows he retains ability at this level.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ultimate Survivor Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Ultimate Survivor has significant improvement to come and gets the right ride.
scenarios.body: His minimal exposure (only recent form /2132-) could be hiding untapped potential, and if he settles better than expected he might have the class edge with his higher OR of 120. The unknown quantity factor works in his favour if others underperform.

watchPoints.text: The Dancing Tree getting an easy lead through the early stages as this would give him a decisive tactical advantage over the hold-up horses
Ultimate Survivor's market movements given his lightly-raced profile and highest official rating could indicate stable confidence in hidden ability
Fame And Concrete's fitness levels after 1136 days off, though connections clearly think he's ready to perform fresh
Practice Run and Mister Splash positioning in the early stages as they'll need to be close enough to strike if the pace collapses
Any jockey changes or significant market support for Tellmesomethingood given his poor recent form but stable connection to likely favourite

races.name: GB Pointing Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: What A Glance
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form who should relish this patient tactical setup and the return to good going after soft ground efforts.

runners_data.name: Alaphilippe
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 364-day absence but has shown enough in pointing to suggest he retains ability despite the lengthy break.

runners_data.name: Laurel Girl
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced mare having first run in over three years with minimal recent evidence but could benefit from the lack of early pace pressure.

runners_data.name: Mister Coffey
runners_data.note: Henderson-trained hold-up performer who fits the race shape perfectly but needs to bounce back from disappointing recent efforts over shorter.

runners_data.name: High Game Royal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good current form who could capitalize if the hold-up horses fail to generate sufficient late momentum.

races.paceDynamic: Alaphilippe will set the early pace from his prominent position, with High Game Royal likely tracking close behind as the only other forward runner in this small field. The sustained galloping test over 3m1½f means Alaphilippe can dictate terms without serious pressure, creating a genuine staying test rather than a sprint finish. With limited early pace and the majority being hold-up horses, this sets up perfectly for the patient types who can produce their best effort late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash a finishing kick after the pace-setters have done the donkey work.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Alaphilippe sets honest fractions without burning out the field completely
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the perfect setup to wind up from the back and overwhelm the leaders in the final half-mile. What A Glance and Mister Coffey can time their runs to perfection when others have shot their bolt.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Stay Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and the hold-up horses fail to generate enough momentum
scenarios.body: Alaphilippe and High Game Royal maintain their advantage as the back markers struggle to make up ground on forgiving going. The prominent runners have enough left in the tank to resist the late challenges over this stamina test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Laurel Girl's long absence masks improved form and she benefits from the lack of pace
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced mare finds another gear after her break and capitalizes on soft fractions to spring a surprise. Her fresher legs prove decisive as others tire from recent exertions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse Up Front
scenarios.trigger: If Alaphilippe's 364-day break tells and he folds tamely when challenged
scenarios.body: The long-absent pace-setter capitulates early leaving High Game Royal isolated in front and vulnerable. This creates a messy race where any of the hold-up horses can profit from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Alaphilippe's jumping under pressure after 364 days off - any early mistakes could derail the pace scenario completely.
What A Glance's ability to handle the step up in trip from his recent shorter efforts where he showed good speed.
Mister Coffey's tactical positioning early - Henderson's runner needs to be patient despite his class advantage on paper.
Laurel Girl's fitness levels after 1353 days away - any market support would be highly significant given the massive break.
High Game Royal's jumping rhythm if asked to go forward earlier than usual to fill any pace void left by Alaphilippe.

races.name: Jonathan Neesom Memorial Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Crawter
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner returning from a mid-length break with proven form on good ground but faces stamina questions over this extended trip.

runners_data.name: Imperial Esprit
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner returning from a long layoff but brings solid course experience and consistent placing record on similar ground.

runners_data.name: Kilfilum Woods
runners_data.note: Solid recent form including a course win but lowest official rating creates significant weight-adjusted disadvantage against classier opposition.

runners_data.name: Corporal Jackjones
runners_data.note: Freshest horse with recent winning form but amateur rider's inexperience could prove costly in tactical situations over this demanding trip.

races.paceDynamic: Imperial Esprit will set a methodical early pace in this small field, with all four runners likely to race prominently given their running styles. The lack of genuine hold-up horses means no tactical pressure from behind, allowing the leader to dictate comfortable fractions through the first half of the race. Crawter and Kilfilum Woods will track closely with Corporal Jackjones also positioned handily, creating a compact group that should remain together until the business end. This sustained, honest gallop over an extended trip clearly favours horses with proven stamina reserves and tactical speed to quicken when the tempo inevitably lifts approaching the final few fences.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Grind
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Esprit maintains steady fractions and the pace doesn't quicken dramatically until late
scenarios.body: The even tempo plays to the strengths of horses who can sustain their effort over this marathon trip without emptying their tanks early. Imperial Esprit's front-running style combined with Crawter's proven class gives them the edge in a staying test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Imperial Esprit from the back straight onwards
scenarios.body: The earlier injection of pace will test stamina reserves and expose any fitness doubts after lengthy layoffs. Crawter's superior class rating and Corporal Jackjones' recent race fitness become decisive factors in a more demanding examination.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Dash Favours Fresh
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early and becomes a sprint finish over the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Horses with tactical speed rather than pure stamina gain the advantage in a finish that resembles a shorter race. Corporal Jackjones' recent run and Kilfilum Woods' lighter build could prove more effective than the bigger, more laboured types.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Esprit faces no serious challenge and is allowed uncontested fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows the leader to conserve energy for a sustained finish that opponents cannot match. Imperial Esprit's experience and proven front-running ability becomes impossible to overcome when gifted soft sectionals.

watchPoints.text: Imperial Esprit's jumping rhythm early doors after 336 days off - any hesitation suggests ring-rustiness will cost him later
How aggressively Crawter's connections position him given the extended trip may test his stamina limits for the first time
Mr Sean O'Connor's tactical decisions on Imperial Esprit with only 3 rides under Rules - positioning errors could prove fatal
Whether Kilfilum Woods can overcome the class gap through superior fitness after his more recent racecourse appearance

races.name: Natural Green Creative Spaces Mares' Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Police Academy
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with strong recent form who benefits from the likely controlled early pace and carries Kelly Morgan's excellent 14-day strike rate

runners_data.name: Hollywood Harmon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tactical pace who could inherit the lead if Loud And Proud falters but hasn't won over similar going recently

runners_data.name: Missed Tee
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with solid recent placings who should get the right race shape but headgear changes suggest connections seeking improvement

runners_data.name: For Rita
runners_data.note: Experienced hold-up performer at 13 years old whose recent form shows she retains ability and suits the likely tactical scenario

runners_data.name: Loud And Proud
runners_data.note: Lone front runner returning from 153-day break whose uncontested lead could prove decisive despite long absence

runners_data.name: Walk Of No Shame
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with strong going record who returns from a 243-day layoff with solid historical form over similar conditions

runners_data.name: All Loved Up
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with lowest rating who faces a significant class challenge despite consistent recent efforts over shorter distances

races.paceDynamic: Loud And Proud is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start without pressure. Hollywood Harmon and All Loved Up as prominent runners may track the leader but are unlikely to challenge early pace. This creates a controlled gallop that will gradually increase through the middle stages before the hold-up horses Police Academy, Missed Tee, For Rita, and Walk Of No Shame make their moves. The sustainable early pace and lack of pace pressure strongly favours hold-up horses who can time their challenges late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Loud And Proud sets uncontested fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks from off the pace. Police Academy and For Rita benefit most from this tactical scenario with their proven ability to close strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front end collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If Loud And Proud stops quickly or Hollywood Harmon pushes the pace earlier than expected
scenarios.body: Hollywood Harmon inherits the lead with All Loved Up tracking, creating a more genuine pace that still suits closers but gives prominent runners a chance. The collapse opens up opportunities for those positioned just behind the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays even from start to finish without significant changes
scenarios.body: Loud And Proud maintains his advantage while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the consistent tempo. This suits horses with tactical speed who can maintain position without using too much energy early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses hit the front simultaneously in the final quarter mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of stamina rather than tactical positioning as several runners challenge together. Walk Of No Shame's recent form and For Rita's experience could prove decisive in a grinding finish.

watchPoints.text: Police Academy's jumping under pressure - 7lb claimer Ellie Callwood needs to keep this hold-up specialist balanced when making his move
Loud And Proud's fitness after 153 days off - any signs of rustiness early could see Hollywood Harmon or All Loved Up challenge for the lead
For Rita's stamina at 13 years old - watch for any signs of fatigue in the final half mile as the pace increases
Walk Of No Shame's early positioning after the long break - Joshua Newman needs to get this hold-up horse into contention before the final turn
Hollywood Harmon's jumping rhythm - any mistakes could compromise Pippa Brown's chances of capitalizing if the front runner weakens

races.name: Foran Equine Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Jeffery's Cross
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent recent form and Dan Skelton stable in good form, ideally positioned to track the leader and strike late.

runners_data.name: My Gift To You
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but 189-day layoff is a concern despite previous good record after breaks under James Owen's patient handling.

runners_data.name: Slipway
runners_data.note: Another prominent runner but 98-day break and 0 from 15 on similar going is worrying, though Molly Armytage's 7lb claim helps.

runners_data.name: Myth Buster
runners_data.note: The lone leader returning after 364 days off, but veteran's class and course experience could see him dictate throughout if fitness holds.

runners_data.name: Peaches And Cream
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage in small field but tongue-tie first time suggests connections seeking improvement.

races.paceDynamic: Myth Buster will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners in this small field of five. The 13-year-old veteran should set a steady, manageable gallop over the extended trip without pressure from fellow prominent runners Jeffery's Cross, My Gift To You, and Slipway who are likely to track rather than challenge early. With only hold-up horse Peaches And Cream sitting back, the pace will be honest but not frantic. This tactical setup strongly favors the prominent runners who can position handily behind Myth Buster and have first strike on the leader, rather than Peaches And Cream who faces a difficult task coming from the back in such a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three prominent runners (Jeffery's Cross, My Gift To You, Slipway) track Myth Buster in an ideal position behind the leader
scenarios.body: They can time their challenges perfectly turning for home while Myth Buster's stamina wanes and Peaches And Cream finds too few to come through. The tactical advantage of racing handy in a small field proves decisive with superior horses able to pick off the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Home
scenarios.trigger: If Myth Buster's 364-day break has freshened him up and the steady pace suits his stamina
scenarios.body: The veteran's class tells as he maintains his advantage to the line with the prominent trio unable to find the extra gear needed. His previous course form and the lack of early pressure allows him to dictate throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the last fence
scenarios.body: Peaches And Cream's natural finishing kick comes to the fore as the prominent runners find themselves flat-footed after tracking a slow pace. The 11-year-old's hold-up style finally pays dividends in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Myth Buster stops quickly and the prominent trio are caught napping by the sudden change of pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical mess with horses changing positions rapidly in the straight. Form goes out the window as it becomes about who adapts quickest to the unfolding drama.

watchPoints.text: Myth Buster's fitness after 364 days off - if he shows early signs of rustiness or breathing issues, the complexion changes completely
My Gift To You's jumping under pressure - recent fall when prominent suggests confidence issues that could resurface if challenged hard
Slipway's response to Molly Armytage's urgings - the 7lb claimer needs the horse to travel kindly given poor recent going record

Peaches And Cream's position turning in - needs to be closer than usual in this small field to have any realistic winning chance

races.name: Carr & Day & Martin Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Unexpected Party
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with highest rating and strong recent form who should track Arthur's Sixpence perfectly.

runners_data.name: Hystery Bere
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 159 days with amateur jockey, faces significant fitness concerns.

runners_data.name: Fan De Blues
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent going form but modest rating faces positioning challenge in slowly-run race.

runners_data.name: Empire De Maulde
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with good going record but returning after 42 days, needs strong pace to be effective.

runners_data.name: Arthur's Sixpence
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning after 42 days who can dictate pace without pressure from fellow leaders.

races.paceDynamic: Arthur's Sixpence will dictate from the front with no other natural leaders in this small field. The three hold-up horses (Hystery Bere, Fan De Blues, Empire De Maulde) will track behind Unexpected Party, who typically races prominently. Arthur's Sixpence can set his own tempo without pressure, creating a controlled pace that may not provide enough pace bias for the hold-up brigade. This measured gallop strongly favours prominent runners and front-runners who can position well early without having to make ground late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Arthur's Sixpence Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Arthur's Sixpence gets an uncontested lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: Arthur's Sixpence dictates throughout and the hold-up horses find insufficient pace to close effectively. The front-runner benefits from the tactical advantage and superior positioning in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Unexpected Party Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Unexpected Party can track Arthur's Sixpence and outbattle him late
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets the perfect trip behind the leader and has enough class edge over the field. Dan Skelton's charge exploits superior form and rating with tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If Arthur's Sixpence goes too fast early or fades dramatically
scenarios.body: One of the three hold-up horses benefits from increased early pace or a collapsing leader. Fan De Blues or Empire De Maulde could profit from their good going form if the race develops differently.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Arthur's Sixpence stops suddenly and Unexpected Party doesn't fire
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no strong pace and tactical positioning breaks down. Any of the hold-up horses could steal it in a weak finish if the front two disappoint.
